title: Promised service tracking
subtitle: Review promised services from paid sponsorships, their dossier preparation and their delivery evidence.
scope: Recorded promised services remain visible before approval. Dossiers with current approved preparation appear first. Publication awaits the required checks and authorizations.
emptyTitle: No promised services in this selection
empty: Change the filters or return after a payment is confirmed and the promised services are recorded.

destination.dossier: Promised services for the linked dossier
destination.choose: Choose the promised service to view from the list.
destination.invalid: This link does not identify a valid dossier and promised service.
destination.empty: No accessible promised service matches this link. Promised services must be recorded before they appear here.

errors.error: Promised services could not be loaded. Try again to get the current data.
errors.forbidden: Your session does not allow you to view promised services.
errors.unavailable: Promised services are temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

detail.title: Promised service details
detail.choose: Select a promised service to see dossier preparation, associated content and delivery evidence.
detail.preparationHelp: These checks and this approval cover the entire sponsorship dossier, including its other promised services. They do not authorize publication.
detail.unknownReason: Open the dossier to examine the next step.
detail.noContent: No content is associated with this publication. Open the sponsorship dossier, Publication tab, to continue preparation.
detail.authorization: An approved preparation does not authorize publication. The exact content, destination and schedule require their own authorization.
detail.noProof: No qualified delivery evidence for this promised service. The recorded agreement is not delivery evidence.
detail.adjusted: A waiver was recorded for this promised service. It does not constitute delivery.

responsibility.none: No remaining action for this promised service.
